fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) rallied 4.3% in the morning in line with AI startup Anthropic's IPO surge, then declined 1.5% as of 2:25 p.m. ET, with approximately $1 billion invested to purchase 13 million shares of Anthropic per share.
fields.summary_ko.1: Broadcom stock is trading at less than 18x net income multiple, with Anthropic's initial IPO surge of 38% increasing Broadcom's stake by approximately $385 million, though most of the subsequent gains were retraced.
